newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE sugar rallies, coffee weaker, cocoa firm PM.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE sugar rallies, coffee weaker, cocoa firm PM.

text.p: SUGAR - August extends gains on supply concerns and after NY stops triggered, drags others higher. Up $3.70 at $317.00.
COFFEE - Cuts losses as NY pushes higher but nearbys still in negative territory. July down $8 at $1,749 at 1430 GMT.
COCOA - Firm across board in tight ranges, light volume. July up two at 1,013 stg.
